text:
Sam (AE): handing Vellum Health to CS — signed today. 12mo, Dedicated 4 GPU + hosted fallback. Key asks: Okta SCIM + two custom SAML attrs (team_id, billing_group), 2yr audit retention, optional VPC peering. Target go-live in ~6 weeks.
Priya (CSM): great — I'll own kickoff and acceptance criteria. Sam pls attach contract and pilot summary.
Sam (AE): contract https://redwood.example/contract/VELLUM-2026. Pilot: stable 100 rps, p95 ~230ms, used streaming and rerank. cost ~on-quote.
Sam (AE): risks: legal retention ask, custom SAML attrs untested, tight timeline for peering if chosen.
Priya (CSM): Mei can you validate SCIM + custom claim mapping on Dedicated? also confirm if we can export audit logs to customer S3 with their KMS for 2yr retention.
Mei (SRE): I can run a staging validation. need Okta metadata or a test admin. audit export to S3 is supported but must verify KMS handshake and lifecycle rules. ETA 48-72h. If custom claim transforms required it could add ~3 business days.
Leo (Support): opening tickets now — SUP-10021 "Vellum: SSO/SCIM validation" & SUP-10022 "Vellum: Audit export/retention". added pilot logs and link to contract. tagging eng-platform.
Priya (CSM): owners/action items: Priya - kickoff + acceptance criteria doc; Mei - SSO/SCIM report + retention options by +72h; Leo - create & triage tickets; Sam - send customer eng contacts and confirm peering decision. Marking Renewal_Risk=medium until retention is validated.
Sam (AE): I'll send contacts and confirm peering preference by EOD. customer also requested clearer per-routing policy cost breakdown — capture for product.
Mei (SRE): plan: 1) request Okta metadata 2) run attribute mapping in staging Dedicated tenant 3) test SCIM provisioning 4) validate audit export -> S3+KMS. will post findings here.
Leo (Support): will update SUP-10021/10022 with Mei's results and escalate to eng-platform if infra changes needed.
Priya (CSM): scheduling kickoff week of May 16; let's do Wed 10am PT. Mei/Leo/Priya to sync earlier if blockers. closing note: logging cost transparency ask to product board after onboarding baseline.
